reply_text:
I answered Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message: the main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals is Thea Ramaswell, Quarrendon's Director of Yard Operations.

That comes from Dana's Aug 20, 2025 post in #north-team, which Marcus can see. She said Thea had flagged the problem again on the morning shift. The same trailer showed twice because the driver checked in at the kiosk and dispatch then added him manually, and Dana was handling it. I couldn't find any later update on the issue in that channel, and I told him that.

Thea's title comes from a Quarrendon contract. I passed on only her name and title, since contacts aren't finance figures and Marcus is on the account's team. No prices or discounts went into the reply.
